items.title: Extract flag parsing and compatibility exports
items.context: Move parseFlags, parseFlagsTest, addValue, coerce, and related helpers into a focused module while preserving existing imports/tests.
items.userSees: Existing flag forms such as --key=value, key=value, repeated arrays, boolean flags, and JSON body payloads continue to parse the same after extraction.

happy.desc: parseFlags and normalizeFlagKey move into packages/main/src/cli/flag-parser.ts while cli-engine.ts keeps compatibility exports and current task imports keep compiling.

edge.desc: Repeated array flags, JSON-array flag values, key=value shorthand, booleans, numbers, and unknown-key preservation behave exactly as before extraction.

adversarial.desc: Invalid structured CLI input still fails with the same validation path and does not get masked by phase-gate or help decoration noise.

items.title: Extract help rendering alias normalization and dry-run handling
items.context: Move help text, command alias normalization, and dry-run parse surfaces out of cli-engine.ts without changing command output or legacy aliases that are still intentionally supported.
items.userSees: Command help, nested lattice aliases, dry-run guidance, and owner lease meta help stay visible and unchanged from a user perspective.

happy.desc: printHelp, printToolHelp, dryRunHelpLine, and normalizeHelpText move into a focused help-renderer module while retaining Lattice branding, command sections, schema argument descriptions, owner lease meta options, and dry-run lines.

edge.desc: Nested space aliases including lattice host runtime list/probe, lattice config doctor, lattice codex verify, autopilot review status, and review escalation status normalize to their flat command names without changing arg consumption.

adversarial.desc: The extraction does not move story_advance lifecycle special dispatch, INIT_CHECK dry-run execution branch, recover_evidence dispatch, story_create bootstrap, hook order, reviewer-readonly gate, or owner lease gate out of cli-engine.ts.

items.title: Verify help flag alias and dry-run behavior
items.context: Run focused CLI smoke commands plus build to prove stdout/stderr, JSON output, and compatibility exports remain stable.
